title: Croissant ML metadata generator + spec validator
context: Tooling that emits Croissant ML metadata (JSON-LD) from a datasheet and validates it against the spec. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Operates only on datasheet metadata (never on data); code is MIT-licensed and must pass build/test/lint in CI.
objective: Build a Croissant ML metadata generator plus a spec validator with golden fixtures, green in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator emits valid Croissant ML (JSON-LD) metadata from a datasheet conforming to the canonical metadata model (template-003).
Spec validator checks emitted Croissant against the Croissant schema and fails on non-conformance.
Committed golden fixtures exercise generator + validator in CI; no real inspected data is committed.
Code MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint green; DCO signed-off; no credentials or secrets.
